Name: Eight Islands Farm
Author: Kattora
Description:
This mod redesigns the original standard farm into eight islands, each with their own benefits. It's perfect for solo players that want a large unique map or for various sized multiplayer games that gives everyone their own space to progress. There are warps located on the main island by the bridge to the bus stop to allow easier travel between islands.

[b]!WARNING![/b]
This mod currently [b][i]replaces [/i][/b]the default farm. If you want to use this map, you need to either A) create a new save file; or B) do not open a save that uses the default farm, while you have this mod downloaded.

This mod does not create a separate farm option. I am new to creating my own mods and have not gained the skill level to required for such a feat completely yet. This specific request of another farm option is a work in progress because I can add it as an option but then there is no furniture in the farmhouse. I will update this mod when I have figured out how to work around that issue.

If you are interested in modifying this mod for any reason, you are required to ask for my permission first.

Thank you and I hope you enjoy the map!
